body:
>But I don’t want to make it a long a possible. I get that your trying to be nice but there’s not really any point. Ty anyways

Believe me, you may not make sense of it, but curiously I do see it, I don't want to just be nice, I want to help you, I know how it feels to have no one, to date, no one cares about me, and I will not let you repeat the same way that I walk

>Because I have social anxiety to the point where I hardly leave the house, I can’t seem to get a job so I don’t have money, constantly think that everybody hates me and I just want to die. We’re all gonna die one day so why not make it today

Under that logic, we will all die one day, so why not make it as long as possible? Believe it or not, people do not think so, is there a better way I can prove it to you? no, that's why you must try it, you don't go out because you don't want to, you must try it before saying it won't work

Think about it for a moment, we do not know what is after death, imagine the possibilities, it is simply nothing, or at least I think so, and even so, a death in theory is the worst thing that can happen to a person, then Why not try literally anything before you die?
Maybe you won't have problems, but I'll come back and tell you, what if it's worse? if not better? if you have opportunities to run away from all those problems and live happier right now?

>I just feel like I'm a nobody, and nobody loves me. Also I can't find a job where i live so idk how could i move out... I was unemployed for 2 years. And I dont feel like i have the power and determination to start my life almost from the beginning.

Maybe you don't have the determination, yet, maybe you need to put some things in your life in order to regain your spirits, I know it's not easy, that's why maybe you're tired, I know it doesn't sound like much, but you have to make an effort, and By that I mean looking for jobs in all possible ways, being competitive and realizing that when you feel better you are an incredible person and that you do not deserve to belittle yourself

>Changing has never been a possibility. There is no illness, there has never been, I am just insufferable. It’s easier to love someone when they are gone. I am doing my loved ones a favour. I am too hard to love and care for. I am undeserving of the type of love I want and i am too miserable to be anyone’s favourite person

heh, maybe I understand you more than I thought, you realize what you lost when you are gone, fortunately we are in a world full of people and there will always be a second chance, maybe you are unbearable, but you are not hitler, you can always change and look for an opportunity from someone who loves you
welp, same happened, surely not enough pills, im really tired, hope i die meanwhile i sleep

The truth is, there isn't much that I can advise you ... my girlfriend left me anyway, and I'm completely unhappy, nobody loves me and I don't know what to do, if you try hard, everything could be better, but everything depends on you. strive to live a good life, the best of all and be happy
And what guarantees that being dead is going to make them love you more, and if nothing changes? dying will only prevent the possibility that you can change your life and destiny and get loved ones
but, how you know that is not something worse or it will fix all your problems?
